annotations.value: Automated change 2025-04-24: GO:0004108 replaced by GO:0036440
SPAPB2B4.06 appears to be a mitochondrial paralogy of the4, but I couldn't find how fatty acids might be generated from fatty-acyl-[ACP]

etr1 enoyl-ACP reductase activity produces the general compound CHEBI:78784 in its Rhea reaction, as it acts at the end of every round of fatty acid elongation in the mitochondria. We have modelled it producing the more specific compound CHEBI:78463 at the end of the final round of elongation, so that we can join it with the first step of the protein lipoylation pathway.
